item.title: Oscar-nominated ‘It Was Just an Accident’ cowriter Mehdi Mahmoudian released from Iranian prison
item.description: The Academy Award–nominated screenwriter was freed on bail after 17 days in custody following his arrest for signing a statement criticizing Iran’s leadership.

item.title: James Cameron to receive 2026 Writers Guild’s lifetime achievement award
item.description: The Titanic and Avatar filmmaker, who has never been nominated for a screenplay Oscar in his storied career, is being recognized for "outstanding contributions to the profession."

item.title: Watch the Oscar-nominated short ‘Jane Austen’s Period Drama’: Directors break down their ‘maximalist’ comedy
item.description: Julia Aks and Steve Pinder chat about fighting menstruation stigma in their live action short film, recruiting a retired costume designer, and meeting their heroes on the road to the Academy Awards.

item.title: 2026 BAFTA Awards: Who’s hosting? Who’s performing? Who’s sitting where? How to watch?
item.description: Leonardo DiCaprio, Timothée Chalamet, Rose Byrne, Jessie Buckley and more descend on London Feb. 22 for the annual ceremony.

item.title: Geeta Gandbhir on making Oscar history with ‘The Perfect Neighbor’ and ‘The Devil Is Busy’
item.description: The filmmaker becomes the first woman nominated for both Documentary Feature and Documentary Short in the same year, driven by stories of women navigating systems that put them at risk.

item.title: ‘Crime 101’: Inside that surprise ending — and how Marvel pals Chris Hemsworth and Mark Ruffalo ‘intimidated’ each other on set
item.description: Director Bart Layton shares behind-the-scenes stories from the making of the film, which also stars Oscar winner Halle Berry and nominees Monica Barbaro and Barry Keoghan.

item.title: How Brad Pitt’s bloody fight with Tom Cruise united Hollywood in an epic battle against AI — and what’s next
item.description: Seedance 2.0, the latest release from TikTok parent company ByteDance, can both produce realistic video and infringe on copyrights.

item.title: ‘Golden’ songwriter Ejae on how the ‘KPop’ anthem has been everywhere from the Oscars to the Olympics to Emily Blunt’s party
item.description: The Oscar-nominated team of Ejae, Mark Sonnenblick, and Joong Gyu Kwak discuss how the earworm celebrates "sisterhood, self-love, and growth."

item.title: From ‘Little Dee’ to ‘Survivor 50’: Dee Valladares on her emotional journey back to the island — and her ideal ‘White Lotus’ role
item.description: Plus, see her thoughts on potentially joining Sandra Diaz-Twine on the Mt. Rushmore of Survivor.
